answer_1.quote: We propose to generate synthetic data in a cross-lingual fashion, borrowing the idea from monolingual QA research efforts. On English corpora, generating synthetic questions has shown to significantly improve the performance of QA models.

Note that the annotators need to have a professional level in the language of the generated question to evaluate its fluency, and to be bilingual, when evaluating its relevance w.r.t. input context in our cross language scenario.
